name: respawn-anchor
normalizations: Compare a respawn anchor charged with glowstone, then used in the Overworld, where it explodes; the crater around it is random and only the anchor's own block is compared.
Use matching flat terrain and ignore clocks, sound seeds and generated IDs.

steps.text: item replace entity @s weapon.mainhand with minecraft:glowstone 4
item replace entity @s weapon.mainhand with minecraft:air
